scope: Curated starting inventory, not exhaustive. Observed schemas in resources/audits; unknowns remain explicit.

datasets.labels: None per clip. Species and region describe the corpus; public viewer feature is audio only.
datasets.starting_point: 1,501 codas; 45 minutes. Smallest whale corpus in this inventory.
datasets.context: One vocal clan near Dominica. No per-file equipment, caller or behavior metadata.
recording, onset, offset; not animal coordinates or behavior.
datasets.license_note: OpenWhistle paper is CC BY 4.0; inspected HF data license field is empty. Do not substitute the article license for a dataset declaration.

datasets.starting_point: balanced-review-sample: 480 rows. balanced: 3,000; unbalanced: 3,488; all: 8,354. Configs overlap and must not be summed as independent samples.
datasets.context: Signature/non-signature whistle types; named signature type does not establish the actual caller. F0 time/frequency/confidence tracks, QC, session and timing; snr_db in all configs.
datasets.license_note: OpenWhistle paper is CC BY 4.0; inspected HF data license field is empty. Do not substitute the article license for a dataset declaration.

datasets.labels: Seven-element multi-label vector ordered SW_Neo, SW_Luna, SW_Nikita, SW_Nana, SW_Yosefa, SW_Dana, NSW_1; all zeros=background. binary_label: noise/whistle.
datasets.starting_point: 5,600 windows of 0.5 seconds; train 3,920, validation/test 840 each.
datasets.context: name and source_label; fixed windows can contain multiple types. No published behavior/position fields.
datasets.license_note: OpenWhistle paper is CC BY 4.0; inspected HF data license field is empty. Do not substitute the article license for a dataset declaration.

datasets.labels: No classification labels. Metadata: start_time, end_time, duration, year, hydrophone.
datasets.starting_point: review-sample: 480 sequences, 1.85 hours (~793 MB card download size). Full: 31,780 sequences, 114.284 hours at 96 kHz.
datasets.context: Hydrophone channel is a recording attribute, not source location. Sequence-level metadata is not a confirmed social interaction label.
datasets.license_note: OpenWhistle paper is CC BY 4.0; inspected HF data license field is empty. Do not substitute the article license for a dataset declaration.

datasets.labels: Species-level archive identification with recording metadata; detailed annotation availability varies by cut and mirror.
datasets.starting_point: Best-of cuts for a broad species comparison; avoid the full archive initially.
datasets.license: WHOI original use statement permits personal/academic use and prohibits commercial use; check each mirror separately.
datasets.context: Cross-species labels, historical dates/places. Species labels are not call meanings.

datasets.starting_point: Inspect public CSVs: 8,719 coda rows and 3,840 dialogue rows (actual file count). No HF DSWP clip alignment established.
datasets.context: Public table includes EC1 and EC2 clan values and unidentified IDN=0 rows. Dialogue Whale codes need interpretation. No verified join to HF numbered clips.

datasets.labels: Observed collated CSV: ClassSpecies=HW,KW,UndBio,AB; Ecotype=SRKW,TKW,NRKW,SAR,OKW,NA. AnnotationLevel=Detection,Call,File. Soundfile,Dataset,LowFreqHz,HighFreqHz,FileEndSec,UTC,FileBeginSec,KW,KW_certain,Provider,FilePath,FileOk.
datasets.starting_point: Authors’ versioned archive (4.9 MB compressed) contains code and collated annotations: 207,574 rows. Paper describes >225,000 provider annotations. Audio archive is ~1.6 TB.
datasets.license: Verify deposited audio terms; article license is not an audio license
datasets.context: Species/ecotype and recording metadata. Time-frequency boxes are not animal coordinates; site/deployment positions are recording positions. Workshop site currently advertises 2027 despite dataset’s 2026 challenge framing.

datasets.labels: Traced signal contours: time, frequency, amplitude; regional source folders.
datasets.starting_point: Read small README first; matched audio/CSV files are bundled in a 5.99 GB ZIP. Exact CSV headers not inspected.
datasets.context: High-frequency modulated signals attributed to killer whales. Function is a hypothesis, not a semantic label.

datasets.labels: Codec tokens and automated quality/detector scores; no human descriptions of song meaning.
datasets.starting_point: Inspect metadata before 29 TAR shards (~1.5 GB each), 488,320 token arrays.
datasets.context: chunk_scores.csv: npy_file, flac_name, chunk_idx_in_flac, whale_cv, energy_ratio, whale_rms, detector_score. Retains source file links; scores are machine-derived.

datasets.labels: Known individual signature whistles connected to age, sex, matrilineal relationships and social associations in longitudinal research.
datasets.starting_point: Read the resource paper and establish access to recordings/linked metadata; not verified as a bulk public ML download.
datasets.license: Access and use terms need confirmation
datasets.context: Richer biological/social metadata than the public binary datasets; collection includes catch-and-release recordings, which affect behavioral interpretation.

datasets.labels: Visual group-minute percentages: foraging, travelling, socializing, milling, attraction to boat; fishing-net/context annotations. 4,637 manually verified whistle contours.
datasets.starting_point: Paper describes internal XLSX observations and JSON contours; public data currently packaged as one 39.9 GB ZIP. Internal schemas not locally inspected.
datasets.context: Bay of Biscay, summers 2020–2022. Four-channel TETRA and sensor geometry support estimated directions, not ready-made individual positions or identities.

datasets.labels: Species, group behavior, group size, calves, call types, vessel/environment context. Behavior: Erratic, Feeding, Feeding/Socialising, Resting, Resting/Travelling, Socialising, Socialising/Resting, Travelling, Travelling/Socialising.
datasets.starting_point: Actual inspected Metadata.xlsx: 36,345 bytes and 35 recordings. Paper calls it CSV. Audio Dataset.zip: 2.3 GB; seven species, 2022–2025.
datasets.context: Latitude/longitude = initial sighting position; behavior/call categories = recording/group context, not per-call intent. Taxonomy contains spelling errors to normalize separately.

datasets.labels: Challenge advertises arrival-time picks, UTC, ground-truth Lat/Lon and UTM derived call localization.
datasets.starting_point: Inspect challenge description and file schema; schema and data terms not yet verified.
datasets.context: Spatial source-location lead rather than call meaning. Fiber-optic cable recordings and derived localization.
